sentences.en: Juha found an egg on the road.

sentences.ar: قال: من هاي البيضة رح تطلع دجاجة.
sentences.en: He said: from this egg a chicken will come.
And from the chicken, many eggs.
And from the eggs, many chickens.
And from the chickens, a lot of money.

sentences.ar: وهو عم يفكر، وقعت البيضة وانكسرت.
sentences.en: While he was thinking, the egg fell and broke.
He said: all my money is gone.
